question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_net_revenue FROM fact_sales;

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_orders FROM fact_sales;

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) FROM fact_sales;

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) FROM dim_customer WHERE customer_key > 0;

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS average_order_value FROM fact_sales;

question: How many units were sold in total?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = false;

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_no LIKE 'C%';

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_cancellations_value FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE;

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM dim_date JOIN fact_sales ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE NOT is_cancelled;

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS gross_sales_before_cancellations FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = FALSE;

question: Which 5 countries generated the highest net revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue,
  dim_country.country_name
FROM
  fact_sales
  JOIN dim_country ON fact_sales.country_key = dim_country.country_key
WHERE
  NOT fact_sales.is_cancelled
GROUP BY
  dim_country.country_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
sql: SELECT dim_product.stock_code, SUM(fact_sales.quantity) AS units_sold FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_product ON fact_sales.product_key = dim_product.product_key WHERE fact_sales.is_cancelled = false GROUP BY dim_product.stock_code ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 products by net revenue?
sql:
SELECT
  dim_product.stock_code,
  SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM
  fact_sales
JOIN
  dim_product ON fact_sales.product_key = dim_product.product_key
WHERE
  fact_sales.is_cancelled = FALSE
GROUP BY
  dim_product.stock_code
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: From how many countries did the shop receive orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fact_sales.country_key) FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_country ON fact_sales.country_key = dim_country.country_key;

question: How much net revenue came from guest checkouts?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_customer ON fact_sales.customer_key = dim_customer.customer_key WHERE dim_customer.is_guest = TRUE;

question: Who are the 5 registered customers with the highest net revenue? Give their customer ids.
sql:
SELECT f.customer_key, c.customer_id
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE c.is_guest = false
AND f.is_cancelled = false
GROUP BY f.customer_key, c.customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(f.line_amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: How many orders came from Germany?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders_from_germany FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_country ON fact_sales.country_key = dim_country.country_key WHERE dim_country.country_name = 'Germany';

question: What net revenue did the product 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' generate?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_product ON fact_sales.product_key = dim_product.product_key WHERE dim_product.description = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHTHOLDER';

question: How many products were ordered by customers from more than 20 different countries?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fact_sales.customer_key) FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_customer ON fact_sales.customer_key = dim_customer.customer_key JOIN dim_country ON fact_sales.country_key = dim_country.country_key GROUP BY fact_sales.customer_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dim_country.country_key) > 20;

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?
sql: SELECT AVG(total_revenue) AS avg_net_revenue_per_registered_customer FROM (SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_revenue, customer_key FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = FALSE GROUP BY customer_key) AS customer_revenue WHERE customer_key != 0;

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
sql: SELECT year, SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
sql:
SELECT
  dim_date.month_name,
  SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM
  fact_sales
JOIN
  dim_date
  ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key
WHERE
  dim_date.year = 2011
  AND NOT fact_sales.is_cancelled
GROUP BY
  dim_date.month_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.month = 11 AND dim_date.year = 2011;

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
sql:
SELECT
  dim_date.quarter,
  SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM
  fact_sales
  JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key
WHERE
  dim_date.year = 2011
  AND NOT fact_sales.is_cancelled
GROUP BY
  dim_date.quarter
ORDER BY
  dim_date.quarter;

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
sql:
WITH revenue_2010 AS (
  SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fact_sales
  JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key
  WHERE dim_date.year = 2010
  AND NOT fact_sales.is_cancelled
),
     revenue_2011 AS (
  SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fact_sales
  JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key
  WHERE dim_date.year = 2011
  AND NOT fact_sales.is_cancelled
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (revenue_2011.total_revenue - revenue_2010.total_revenue) * 100.0 / revenue_2010.total_revenue,
    2
  ) AS growth_percentage
FROM revenue_2010, revenue_2011;

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS weekend_orders FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.is_weekend = TRUE;

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
sql: SELECT day_name, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS order_count FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY day_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days';

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS new_customers FROM dim_customer WHERE customer_key IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_key FROM fact_sales WHERE date_key BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(date_key) FROM dim_date WHERE year = 2011) AND (SELECT MAX(date_key) FROM dim_date WHERE year = 2011)) AND customer_key > 0;

question: By how much did net revenue change from September 2011 to October 2011 (October minus September)?
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2011-09-01' AND '2011-09-30' THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_september,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2011-10-01' AND '2011-10-31' THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_october,
  SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2011-10-01' AND '2011-10-31' THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2011-09-01' AND '2011-09-30' THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_change
FROM fact_sales
JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key
WHERE dim_date.year = 2011
  AND dim_date.month IN (9, 10);

question: What was the gross margin in 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS total_cost FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.year = 2011 AND is_cancelled = FALSE;
